description_en: Queries the price of an instance
description_zh: 该接口用于查询RDS实例的价格信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-price --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine MySQL --engine-version 8.0 --db-instance-class mysql.x2.medium.xc --db-instance-storage 20 --quantity 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrice

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The commodity code of the instance. Valid values:

bards: The instance is a pay-as-you-go primary instance. This value is available at the China site (aliyun.com).
rds (default): The instance is a subscription primary instance. This value is available at the China site (aliyun.com).
rords: The instance is a pay-as-you-go read-only instance. This value is available at the China site (aliyun.com).
rds_rordspre_public_cn: The instance is a subscription read-only instance. This value is available at the China site (aliyun.com).
bards_intl: The instance is a pay-as-you-go primary instance. This value is available at the international site (alibabacloud.com).
rds_intl: The instance is a subscription primary instance. This value is available at the international site (alibabacloud.com).
rords_intl: The instance is a pay-as-you-go read-only instance. This value is available at the international site (alibabacloud.com).
rds_rordspre_public_intl: The instance is a subscription read-only instance. This value is available at the international site (alibabacloud.com).

If you want to query the price of a read-only instance, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
当前实例的商品码，取值：

bards：主实例按量付费（中国站）
rds（默认）：主实例包年包月（中国站）
rords：只读实例按量付费（中国站）
rds_rordspre_public_cn：只读实例包年包月（中国站）
bards_intl：主实例按量付费（国际站）
rds_intl：主实例包年包月（国际站）
rords_intl：只读实例按量付费（国际站）
rds_rordspre_public_intl：只读实例包年包月（国际站）

查询只读实例时必须传入本参数
parameters.name: commodity_code

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the instance. Valid values:

MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
MariaDB
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version of the instance. Valid values:

Valid values if you set Engine to MySQL: 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0
Valid values if you set Engine to SQL Server: 08r2_ent_ha(cloud disks, discontinued), 2008r2(high-performance local disks, discontinued), 2012 (SQL Server EE Basic)2012_ent_ha, 2012_std_ha, 2012_web, 2016_ent_ha, 2016_std_ha, 2016_web, 2017_ent, 2017_std_ha, 2017_web, 2019_ent, 2019_std_ha, 2019_web, 2022_ent, 2022_std_ha, and 2022_web
Valid values if you set Engine to PostgreSQL: 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, and 15.0
Valid value if you set Engine to MariaDB: 10.3

The following information describes the valid values when you set Engine to SQLServer: `_ent` specifies SQL Server EE on RDS Cluster Edition, `_ent_ha` specifies SQL Server EE, `_std_ha` specifies SQL Server SE, and `_web` specifies SQL Server Web
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">数据库版本，取值：
MySQL：5.5、5.6、5.7、8.0
SQL Server：08r2_ent_ha（云盘版，已停售）、2008r2（高性能本地盘，已停售）、2012（企业版单机）、2012_ent_ha、2012_std_ha、2012_web、2014_ent_ha、2014_std_ha、2016_ent_ha、2016_std_ha、2016_web、2017_ent、2017_std_ha、2017_web、2019_ent、2019_std_ha、2019_web、2022_ent、2022_std_ha、2022_web
PostgreSQL：10.0、11.0、12.0、13.0、14.0、15.0
MariaDB：10.3</props>



<props="intl">数据库版本，取值：
MySQL：5.5、5.6、5.7、8.0
SQL Server：08r2_ent_ha（云盘版，已停售）、2008r2（高性能本地盘，已停售）、2012（企业版单机）、2012_ent_ha、2012_std_ha、2012_web、2016_ent_ha、2016_std_ha、2016_web、2017_ent、2017_std_ha、2017_web、2019_ent、2019_std_ha、2019_web、2022_ent、2022_std_ha、2022_web
PostgreSQL：10.0、11.0、12.0、13.0、14.0、15.0
MariaDB：10.3</props>

SQL Server实例中`_ent`表示企业集群版、`_ent_ha`表示企业版、`_std_ha`表示标准版、`_web`表示Web版
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB. You can increase the storage capacity at a step size of 5 GB. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh: 实例存储空间，单位：GB。每5 GB进行递增，取值范围请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the primary instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent zone list.

If you specify a virtual private cloud (VPC) and a vSwitch, this parameter is required to identify the zone for the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
主节点可用区ID。可调用DescribeRegions获取。

指定了VPC和交换机时，为匹配交换机对应的可用区，该参数必填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance.

If you set the TimeType parameter to Year, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 100.
If you set the TimeType parameter to Month, the value of the UsedTime parameter ranges from 1 to 999.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长，取值：
当参数TimeType为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~100。
当参数TimeType为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~999。

默认值：1
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. This parameter is required when CommodityCode is set to rds, rds_rordspre_public_cn, rds_intl, or rds_rordspre_public_intl. Valid values:

Year
Month
parameters.help_zh:
包年包月的付费类型，当CommodityCode参数的值为rds、rds_rordspre_public_cn、rds_intl或rds_rordspre_public_intl时必传。取值：
Year：包年
Month：包月
parameters.name: time_type

parameters.help_en: The number of instances that you want to purchase. Valid values: 0 to 30
parameters.help_zh: 购买实例的数量，取值范围：0~30
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.help_en:
The role of the instance. Valid values:

0: primary instance
3: read-only instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型，取值：
0：主实例
3：只读实例
parameters.name: instance_used_type

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:

BUY
RENEW
UPGRADE
DOWNGRADE
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型，取值：
BUY：购买
RENEW：续费
UPGRADE：升级
DOWNGRADE：降级
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the new instance. Valid values:

general_essd: premium Enterprise SSD (ESSD)
local_ssd: premium local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: performance level 1 (PL1) ESSD
cloud_essd2: PL2 ESSD
cloud_essd3: PL3 ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
general_essd：高性能云盘
local_ssd：高性能本地盘
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
parameters.name: db_instance_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance for which you want to change the specifications or the instance that you want to renew.

If you want to query the price of a specification change order or a renewal order, you must specify this parameter.
If the instance is a read-only instance, you must set this parameter to the ID of its primary instance
parameters.help_zh:
变配或续费的实例ID。
需要查询实例变配或续费价格时需要传入该参数。
如果为只读实例，则需要传入其主实例的ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

fields.help_en: The instance type of the node
fields.name: class_code

fields.help_en: The zone ID of the node
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The information about the node.

This parameter is supported for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances that run RDS Cluster Edition
parameters.help_zh:
节点相关信息。
该参数用于MySQL集群系列实例
parameters.name: db_node

fields.help_en: The maximum number of RDS Capacity Units (RCUs)
fields.help_zh: 实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）的自动扩缩范围最大值
fields.name: max_capacity

fields.help_zh: 实例RCU（RDS Capacity Unit）的自动扩缩范围最小值
fields.name: min_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The settings of the serverless instance.

ApsaraDB RDS for MariaDB does not support serverless instances
parameters.help_zh:
RDS Serverless实例的相关设置。
MariaDB不支持Serverless实例
parameters.name: serverless_config

OrderParams.description_en:
The order parameters.

If the OrderParamOut parameter is set to true, the value of the OrderParams parameter is returned
OrderParams.description_zh:
订单参数。
仅当OrderParamOut参数传入true时，返回该参数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code that is returned

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

TradePrice.description_zh: 最终价，为原价减去折扣

storageDiscountAmount.description_en: The discounted price of the disk capacity

ShowDiscount.description_en: Indicates whether discounts can be used

TradeMaxRCUAmount.description_zh: 根据用户所选择的最大RCU计算出的每小时费用预估

TradeMinRCUAmount.description_zh: 根据用户所选择的最小RCU计算出的每小时费用预估
